subject: Final pass: OKR narratives and evidence portfolio — leadership signoff needed
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final pass: OKR narratives and evidence portfolio — leadership signoff needed

Team —

Attached is the curated evidence index and the narrative draft for Q2 close. Aim here is to produce a tight executive narrative (1–2 pgs) that links the score decisions to concrete evidence. High level asks: 

- Vivek: confirm top-level objective scores and any contested evidence by EOD Monday (past-due items flagged in the sheet).
- Marissa: finalize the short narratives per objective (bulleted premise + 2 supporting evidence points).
- Laura: review tone and executive summary; surface anything that should be escalated to the CEO call.
- Karthik: ensure the appendix contains required audit artifacts for SOC2 reviewers and procurement requests (BrightArc asks).

I've also added two external items BrightArc raised (procurement timeline and audit snapshot). Those are in the evidence index and flagged with orange.

Deliverable timeline: first pass comments by Mon 10:00 PT, final docs by Tue 17:00 PT for leadership review Wed.

Attachments: OKR_evidence_index_Q2_2027.pdf, scoring_sheet_20270725.xlsx, narrative_draft_v3.docx

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: OKR narratives and evidence portfolio — leadership signoff needed

Irene —

Thanks for the bundle. Quick notes after a skim of scoring_sheet_20270725: 

1) Objective 1 (Serving runtime performance): I propose moving from 8 -> 9 based on the 15% p99 latency improvement and new kernel selection rollout (evidence refs E1, E3). I flagged the supporting benchmark CSV in the sheet.

2) Objective 3 (Dedicated capacity stability): still noisy. There's a post-rollout regression on one customer tenant (BrightArc). Karthik — can you add the incident postmortem link to the appendix (I couldn't find it).

3) Narrative: suggest trimming technical depth in the exec summary and adding a one-line customer impact statement for each objective.

I'll upload my annotated scoring sheet by 10:30 PT. If we need to call out an exception for Objective 3 I can draft a one-paragraph remediation note.

-Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: OKR narratives and evidence portfolio — leadership signoff needed

On Mon, Jul 26, 2027 at 08:44, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene —
> 
> Thanks for the bundle. Quick notes after a skim of scoring_sheet_20270725: 
> 
> 1) Objective 1 (Serving runtime performance): I propose moving from 8 -> 9 based on the 15% p99 latency improvement and new kernel selection rollout (evidence refs E1, E3).

Thanks — I pulled together the short narratives and attached the updated narrative_draft_v3.docx (v3.1). Highlights:

- Objective 1 summary: "Significant latency wins from kernel selection and batch tuning; net customer latency reduced; continued work on tail latencies." Evidence: E1 (benchmark CSV), E4 (customer timing traces).
- Objective 2 summary: "Rollout of model routing policies completed; early cost wins but gating on A/B dice roll for stability." Evidence: E6, E7.
- Objective 3 summary: "Stability improved generally but BrightArc tenant regression requires remediation and a controlled rollback; propose a canary policy change and a customer credit conversation." Evidence: E9 (incident), E10 (support logs).

Attachments in my reply: scoring_sheet_20270725.xlsx (annotated), narrative_draft_v3.docx (v3.1).

Marissa
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: OKR narratives and evidence portfolio — leadership signoff needed

Team —

Good work on tightening the narratives. A couple editing asks before we hand to Scott: 

- Tone: drop technical parentheticals in the executive summary; use customer impact language (e.g., "reduced customer tail latency by 15% leading to X fewer timeouts per week").
- Escalation: add a one-line "risk" callout for Objective 3 and include proposed customer relief (credit or SLA extension).
- Appendix: Karthik please confirm SOC2 artifact list and add dates for each log export.

Also — Emily Park at BrightArc pinged procurement for our audit snapshot. CC'd procurement@acmehealth.com below as a sample request we received; we should ensure any shared artifacts are tagged in the evidence index and shared via the secure Drive folder (link in my comments).

I uploaded a redline of narrative_draft_v3.docx (v3.2) — minor tone edits and an executive one-paragraph lead.

Laura
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: OKR narratives and evidence portfolio — leadership signoff needed

Folks —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Plan:

- Marissa and Laura will merge edits into narrative_draft_v3.docx -> v4 and I'll circulate final PDF to Scott and the execs Wed AM.
- Vivek: confirm the 8->9 promotion for Objective 1 in the scoring sheet by 10:00 PT Wed.
- Karthik: please upload the SOC2 artifact list and the BrightArc incident postmortem into the Drive folder and add the filenames to the evidence index (I need the exact filenames for compliance).

If nobody flags further contested scores before Wed 10:00 PT I'll consider the package signed off and schedule the leadership readout. If BrightArc asks for additional logs we'll handle through the secure folder and a signed access request.

Thanks — final push.

Irene
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
